missionSuccessStatementOverride: Well done, that was not a mission I was happy to assign to you.
badFaithStatementOverride: You fled in fear and left my people to die, that is inexcusable.
goodFaithStatementOverride: No one could really expect more than what you did today, Commander.
shortDescription: Be careful, Commander. We need this facility, but you and our own troops are at risk of significant impacts from the bioweapons that might be present. Destroy the garrison and target as quickly as possible to reduce the chance of exposure. Remember, speed is of the essence, do not take longer than you have to.
longDescription: I'd really prefer we did not take this mission, Commander. A $1 million loss seems trivial against what we could encounter.

contractObjectiveList.title: Destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} communications facility and Escape
contractObjectiveList.description: Cripple the enemy's communications capacity to respond to future hostilities

dialogueContent.words: We need to be quick about this, Commander. The pathogen here can get past our NBC protection, so the longer we stay, the more harm comes to our people. Let's get in fast, take out the site and the garrison and then bug out.
Well done, that was not a mission I wanted to be on. Let's hope our people are ok.
That was a tough loss, in a tough situation.
More Commandos are coming in at us, Commander.
Mission accomplished, now to get the hell away from this cursed place. Head for you evac ASAP.
Nice shooting, drop those labs so we can get out of here.
That's it, Commander, now for the rest.
That's the garrison out of the picture.
